name: Japan Invoice (NTA T-Number Mod-9) + Dencho-ho Naming + Zengin 120B CP932 Backoffice Pipeline

parameters.content:
## 03 · Japan Invoice + Dencho-ho + Zengin Backoffice Pipeline

Automates end-to-end Japanese accounts-payable compliance from a single webhook intake:
1. **NTA Qualified Invoice ID (`T` + 13 digits)** mathematical Modulo-9 check-digit verification (`9 - (weighted_sum % 9)`).
2. **Electronic Books Preservation Act (改正電子帳簿保存法)** filename normalization (`YYYYMMDD_Vendor_Amount.pdf`) + 3 statutory search keys.
3. **Bank-ready Zengin 120-Byte fixed-length transfer file** (`種別21 総合振込`, JIS X 0201 / CP932 half-width katakana bytes) + Slack finance approval + Google Sheets search ledger.

### Required Environment Variables
- `ZENGIN_CLIENT_CODE` (10-digit requester code)
- `ZENGIN_SENDER_KANA` (half-width katakana sender name)
- `ZENGIN_SENDER_BANK_CODE` (4 digits, e.g. `0005`)
- `ZENGIN_SENDER_BRANCH_CODE` (3 digits, e.g. `001`)
- `ZENGIN_SENDER_ACCOUNT_NO` (7 digits)
- `GOOGLE_DENCHO_SHEET_ID` (Dencho-ho ledger spreadsheet ID)
- `SLACK_FINANCE_CHANNEL` (e.g. `#jp-keiri-approval`)

nodes.name: Sticky Note — JP Invoice & Zengin Setup

parameters.content:
## NTA Modulo-9 & Dencho-ho Rules

- Strips full-width characters (`Ｔ１２３...` -> `T123...`) and validates check digit `digits[0] === 9 - (sum % 9)` with weights `[1, 2]` from right across digits `2..13`.
- Converts Gregorian (`2026-11-20`, `2026年11月20日`) and Wareki (`令和8年11月20日`, `R8.11.20`) dates into `YYYYMMDD`.
- Rejects invalid T-numbers or missing amount/vendor keys with HTTP `422` + Slack exception alert (zero silent passes).

## Zengin 120-Byte CP932 Export

Builds strict 120-byte fixed-length Header (`1`), Data (`2`), Trailer (`8`), and End (`9`) records encoded directly to single-byte ASCII + JIS X 0201 Half-Width Katakana (`0xA6..0xDF`, CP932-identical) so MUFG BizSTATION / SMBC Web21 / Rakuten / SBI accept the file without Mojibake.
